A.title: Lantern Stair Custom
A.text: Take a lantern from the hook as you enter; leave one lit at the bottom. That is the rule, and the market keeps accounts. Come in with no lantern and you owe a debt.

Y.title: Paper Bridge, Fire
Y.text: The bridge is paper over rope; it takes one person at a time; no open flame, no torch. If you carry a lantern, hold it low and away. I saw it go up in a breath.

R.title: A Door Half Seen
R.text: Some doors in the Mask Gallery are only half there. Look at them from the corner of the eye and they firm up. Look straight and they fade; the dead walk through them like a dream.

G.title: Broker's Ledger, Page One
G.text: Debts owed: forty-one. Debts paid: one; the one is marked in red. The ledger does not say who paid; it says only, thank you.

M.title: The Rules of the Market
M.text: One: no haggling after dark; Two: no looking at the faces behind the masks. Three: if a ghost offers a price, take it. Four: you do not leave until the bell; Five: the bell does not ring.

O.title: Pawnshop Notice
O.text: We buy anything. Boots, names, years; a man pawned a year of his life for a lamp. He was twenty; he looked forty when he came out; check what you sell.

U.title: Hungry Alley, Careful
U.text: The alley is narrow and the hungry things are quick; they are not ghosts. They are people who stayed too long at the bazaar. Shove them and run; do not give them food.

X.title: The Ghost Broker
X.text: He sits at the counter with a ledger and no face. He will buy and sell anything; he has been at it since before the Accord. He has never once been cheated, and neither has he cheated anyone.
